material.paper_title: Synthetic mechanical response of two specimens
paragraphs: The modulus of specimen A is 3.2 GPa under 1 mm/min. Specimen B reached 4.1 GPa in the same run.
Load-displacement curves were recorded at 1 mm/min; the legend lists A (red) before B (blue).
